Article Name: Curing-dependent behaviors of sustainable alkali-activated fiber reinforced composite: Temperature and humidity effects
Author: Lili Kan, Yuan-qiao Gan, Wei Dai, Luo-hao Lv, Lan-qing Dai, Jia-bao Zhai, Fei Wang
Curing method: sealed 24 h, demolded, dry curing 20 C RH 60 % to 27 d
Conversions / notes: Dry curing. Table 1 gives mix in wt% of total mix (GGBS 46.24, SF 11.56, sand 17.34, NaOH 2.08, Na2SiO3 solution 9.48, water 13.29, PE 2 vol%); all ratios = wt% / binder wt% (B = GGBS + SF = 57.80 wt%). Sodium silicate solution is water glass (SiO2/Na2O 3.3, water 64.16 %); its water is not in W/B. Solid NaOH granules 99 %. Sand = river sand (Fig 2 caption). Tensile values are mean of >=3 dog-bone specimens, strain = strain at peak stress. Compressive strength only in Fig 8 (no number) so left blank. Test age 28 d is implied by curing 'to 27 d/28 d' after 24 h sealed (not stated as a separate sentence); curing time column = age at test. Compressive cube 50 mm (Sec 2.3.2). Low-temp RH not stated.
